entry: One voxel agent researches, reproduces, runs these stages, verifies and records feedback.
preflight: planWorld: independent seed streams choose biome, transitions, landform, size, density, settlements, boats and light

stages.output: Heights, biomes, cave roof, water beds, shores and landmarks
Moisture, substrate, coherent patches and distance to water
Stable shape recipes, global canopy and dressing quotas
Measured buildings on supported lots with safe entrances
Accepted natural parents and bounded companion recipes
Supported walking routes and protected headroom
Companion trees placed before ambient canopy
Large-first canopy, habitat patches and clearings
Actual canopy cover for groundcover placement
Related supplies, vegetation, landmarks and static wildlife
Closed, beveled geological boundary, foundations and cave roofs connected to actual rock
Optional boats on equal-level navigable water
Camera destinations bounded by accepted geometry
Fail closed if geometry exceeds policy

postflight: Mesh exact exposed faces with contact AO
Build GPU water and batched weather
Fit camera and actual place bounds; keep eyes outside solids and clear the focused subject region
Run fixtures, content, volume/mesh, ecology, groups, diversity and motion checks
Build; run real browser, GPU and figure audits; inspect overview/detail/phone/model sheets
Keep failed seeds and judgments; export full source, scripts, pipeline, rules and evidence to the vault
